items.title: Fed穆薩林挺升息！不應為AI生產力容忍高通膨
items.title_en: Fed Musalem Pushes Rate Hike! Should Not Tolerate High Inflation for AI‑Driven Productivity
paras: 聖路易聯邦準備銀行總裁穆薩林 (Alberto Musalem) 周四 (5 日) 加入多名官員支持 7 月升息的行列，表示在當前環境下，貨幣政策的首要任務是對潛在通膨形成實質的抑制效果，而非容忍當前較高的通膨，只為追求未來生產力成長。
聯準會 (Fed) 在 7 月 28 日至 29 日會議決議維持利率不變，但有三位決策官員投下反對票，主張應升息。另有多位官員近期也表示，若不及早採取行動，通膨恐將更加頑強，Fed 未來可能必須升息。
穆薩林今年沒有聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 投票權，但他表示自己在 7 月會議上主張將聯邦基金利率調高 1 碼 (25 個基點)。他也表示，會後美國公債遭拋售，再次凸顯維持 Fed 公信力的重要性。
穆薩林指出，支持升息的主要原因是，如果貨幣政策維持目前水準，未來一年左右通膨持續高於 Fed 2% 目標的機率相當高。他還表示，現在就採取行動的另一個理由是，「提早進行循序漸進的小幅升息，比日後被迫採取更劇烈的利率調整，更不具干擾性、成本也更低。」

AI 有助生產力 但不能拿來當容忍通膨的理由

部分經濟學家及 Fed 主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 認為，人工智慧 (AI) 有望提升生產力，並在長期紓解通膨壓力。不過，華許在 7 月會後坦言，相關效益何時顯現仍具高度不確定性。
穆薩林表示，具限制性的貨幣政策雖然可能拖慢創新及生產力成長，但 Fed 不能把市場對其控制通膨能力的信心視為理所當然。
他警告：「如果市場認為央行願意容忍高於目標的通膨，只因寄望未來生產力大幅提升，將危及通膨預期的錨定。一旦公信力流失，重建代價將非常高。」
美國本周五將公布最新就業報告，下周則將公布新一輪通膨數據。穆薩林表示，美國經濟近月來依然展現韌性，勞動市場已趨於穩定，就業人數持續穩健成長，失業率也維持在接近長期均衡水準。
paras_en: St. Louis Federal Reserve Bank President Alberto Musalem joined several officials on Thursday (the 5th) in supporting a July rate hike, saying that in the current environment the primary task of monetary policy is to exert a real restraining effect on underlying inflation rather than tolerate the presently elevated inflation simply to chase future productivity growth.

The Fed’s July 28‑29 meeting resolved to keep rates unchanged, but three voting members cast dissenting votes urging a hike. Several other officials have recently warned that without early action inflation could become more entrenched, forcing the Fed to raise rates later.

Musalem does not have a vote on this year’s Federal Open Market Committee, yet he said he advocated a one‑point (25‑basis‑point) increase in the federal funds rate at the July meeting. He also noted that Treasury bonds were sold off after the meeting, underscoring the importance of preserving the Fed’s credibility.

He explained that the main reason to support a hike is that, if policy stays at current levels, the odds are high that inflation will remain above the Fed’s 2% target for roughly the next year. He added that acting now with a modest, gradual increase is less disruptive and cheaper than being forced later to make a more aggressive adjustment.

AI can boost productivity but should not be used as a justification for tolerating inflation. Some economists and former Fed chair Kevin Warsh see AI as a potential long‑term productivity driver that could ease inflation pressures, but Warsh admitted after the July meeting that the timing of any benefits remains highly uncertain.
Musalem said that while restrictive policy may slow innovation and productivity growth, the Fed cannot take market confidence in its inflation‑controlling ability for granted.

He warned, “If the market believes the central bank will tolerate inflation above target because it hopes for a big future productivity jump, it will jeopardize the anchoring of inflation expectations. Once credibility is lost, the cost of rebuilding it will be very high.”

The United States will release its latest jobs report on Friday and new inflation data next week. Musalem noted that the U.S. economy has remained resilient in recent months, the labor market has stabilized, employment continues to grow steadily, and the unemployment rate remains near its long‑term equilibrium level.

items.title: 預測平台Kalshi交易者：標普年底有很高機率衝破8000點 站上8200機率達三分之一
items.title_en: Forecast platform Kalshi traders: S&P has a high chance of breaking 8,000 points by year‑end, odds of reaching 8,200 about one‑third
paras: 預測交易平台 Kalshi 最新合約顯示，交易員押注標普 500 指數今年收盤站上 8000 點的機率約 66%。
Kalshi 合約以 Google Finance 收盤價結算，投機者另押注今年觸及 8200 點機率約 33%。
驅動標普近日連漲的催化劑包括美伊緊張降溫、美企 Q2 財報普遍擊敗預期及 Leopold Aschenbrenner 旗下「態勢感知基金」瀕臨清算釋出再配置資金。
市場前兩個月曾大幅減持 AI 成長股，指數靠輪動至金融、工業與公用事業掩蓋內部分化，但 AI 算力鏈回穩後，寬基 ETF 再次由科技權值帶頭。
多數賣方不把 6-7 月整理視為 AI 牛市終結。Truist 首席市場策略師 Keith Lerner 直言，企業獲利上修、美國經濟具韌性、市場廣度改善，「這種環境通常不是牛市尾聲」。
Kalshi 的 66% 機率雖非機構共識，但反映散戶與量化資金對「獲利驅動 + 利率回落」組合的定價。若 10 年期美債殖利率穩住 4.7% 下方、聯準會 (Fed) 年內不重啟升息，8000 點將從情緒目標變成可結算路徑。
paras_en: The latest contract on the prediction‑trading platform Kalshi shows that traders are betting the probability that the S&P 500 will close above 8,000 points this year is about 66%.
Kalshi contracts settle at the Google Finance closing price, and speculators also wager the probability of hitting 8,200 points this year at roughly 33%.

Catalysts driving the recent rally in the S&P include a cooling of U.S.–Iran tensions, U.S. companies' Q2 earnings generally beating expectations, and the near‑liquidation of Leopold Aschenbrenner’s “Situational Awareness Fund,” which is releasing capital for reallocation.

In the first two months, the market sharply reduced exposure to AI growth stocks, with the index rotating into financials, industrials and utilities to mask internal divergence, but after the AI compute chain stabilized, broad‑based ETFs again led the rally with tech weighting.

Most sell‑side analysts do not view the June‑July consolidation as the end of the AI bull market. Truist chief market strategist Keith Lerner said outright that corporate profit upgrades, a resilient U.S. economy, and improving market breadth mean “this kind of environment is usually not the tail end of a bull market.”

Kalshi’s 66% probability is not an institutional consensus, but it reflects retail and quantitative capital pricing the “profit‑driven + rate‑cut” combination. If the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield holds below 4.7% and the Fed does not restart rate hikes this year, 8,000 points will shift from a sentiment target to a realizable path.

paras_en: Today's pre‑market outlook

U.S. President Trump signed an announcement on Thursday (the 6th) invoking Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962 to impose a 15% tariff on imported polysilicon‑derived products and to set a minimum import price, citing excessive foreign reliance as a national‑security risk. The new measures will take effect on December 4. According to the notice, imported polysilicon derivatives—including silicon wafers, solar cells and solar modules—will be subject to the 15% tariff.

The U.S. Department of Commerce announced on Thursday (the 6th) that it will ban the export of tungsten waste and battery waste to strengthen domestic recycling and boost the supply chain for critical minerals. President Trump had signed an executive order the previous week authorizing federal officials to restrict exports of waste containing high‑value critical minerals to China and other countries. The prohibited items include the material colloquially known as “black powder,” i.e., crushed lithium‑ion battery waste, as well as waste containing tungsten.

SanDisk (SNDK‑US) saw its stock plunge 6.8% on Thursday (the 6th) after the flash‑memory and storage‑device maker posted first‑quarter revenue guidance for fiscal 2027 that fell short of analysts’ expectations. Management said customer demand still exceeds supply, so the memory allocation regime is expected to continue beyond 2027, meaning the company will keep rationing memory shipments to customers.

Elon Musk’s business empire spans energy, electric vehicles, rockets, robotics and AI, all underpinned by his ability to attract, shape and monetize global attention. However, a Bloomberg column notes that the “attention economy” that has buoyed the lofty valuations of Tesla (TSLA‑US) and SpaceX (SPCX‑US) is waning, with investors growing weary of Musk’s ever‑expanding sci‑fi visions, leading to a $1.4 trillion erosion in market value for the two companies.

The AI dividend’s beneficiaries are being questioned as U.S. labor compensation’s share of GDP fell to its lowest level since 1947 in the second quarter. While Q2 labor‑productivity growth outpaced expectations—rising at an annualized 1.4% versus the revised 0.8% in Q1 and beating all but one economist’s forecast in a Bloomberg survey—higher productivity has not fully translated into higher wages, shrinking the labor‑share of economic output.

items.title: 川普祭232條款！多晶矽產品課15%關稅並設最低進口價 12月生效
items.title_en: Trump Signs 232 Provisions! 15% Tariff on Polysilicon Products and Minimum Import Price of $12 per Kilogram to Take Effect in December
paras: 美國總統川普周四 (6 日) 簽署公告，依據《1962 年貿易擴張法》第 232 條，對進口多晶矽 (polysilicon) 衍生產品課徵 15% 關稅，並同步設立最低進口價格，理由是美國過度依賴外國供應已危及國家安全。
新措施將於 12 月 4 日生效。根據公告，進口多晶矽衍生產品，包括矽晶圓、太陽能電池及太陽能模組等，都將適用於 15% 關稅。
公告中也指出，多晶矽最低進口價格訂為每公斤 21 美元，多晶矽錠與矽晶圓每公斤 100 美元，太陽能電池每瓦 0.22 美元，太陽能模組每瓦 0.38 美元。
多晶矽是一種超高純度矽材料，為半導體與太陽能產業供應鏈最上游原料。製造商先將其製成矽晶圓，再加工為太陽能電池，最後組裝成太陽能模組。
受消息激勵，美國太陽能製造商盤後股價走高。美國最大太陽能製造商第一太陽能 (First Solar)(FSLR-US) 一度大漲 8%，T1 Energy(TE-US)一度漲 6.3%。
川普此舉主要針對中國競爭，希望扶植美國本土多晶矽及相關產品生產，建立完整的美國太陽能供應鏈。
美國在 2000 年代初期至中期曾是全球主要多晶矽生產國，但後來中國企業快速崛起，至 2010 年代末已成為全球最大供應者。這十多年來，美國一直試圖重建美國的太陽能製造能力，但成效有限。
近年來，美國已多次對中國及部分東南亞國家的太陽能設備祭出反傾銷及反補貼措施，並指控部分海外業者藉由轉移生產地規避關稅。
不過，新關稅也可能推高太陽能模組成本，對原本已面臨聯邦補貼取消、且須因應川普政府偏向支持化石燃料政策的再生能源開發商，帶來新的壓力。

提供投資誘因 鼓勵回流美國設廠

川普也要求商務部建立投資獎勵機制，鼓勵企業赴美設立多晶矽及衍生產品工廠。
根據行政命令，商務部長可與企業簽訂個別投資協議，提供投資誘因。提出「回流美國」(onshoring) 計畫且獲批准的企業，還可免除部分生產設備及原料的新增關稅。
「繁榮美國聯盟」(Coalition for a Prosperous America) 主席 Jon Toomey 說：「這是美國首次透過單一政策保護整個太陽能供應鏈，同時獎勵在美投資設廠企業，也是強化本土半導體供應鏈的重要一步。」
不過，新措施延至 12 月才實施，引發部分美國製造商不滿。他們認為，這將讓再生能源開發商有時間大量進口低價產品並建立免稅庫存。
對此川普在公告中表示，政府將持續監控貿易流向，若發現企業藉機囤積多晶矽或相關產品，將採取限制措施。
paras_en: US President Trump signed an announcement on Thursday (6th) to impose a 15% tariff on imported polysilicon-derived products, including silicon wafers, solar cells, and solar modules, under Section 232 of the 1962 Trade Expansion Act, citing national security concerns due to over-reliance on foreign suppliers.

The new measures will take effect on December 4th. According to the announcement, all polysilicon-derived products, including silicon wafers, solar cells, and solar modules, will be subject to a 15% tariff.

The announcement also sets a minimum import price of $21 per kilogram for polysilicon, $100 per kilogram for polysilicon ingots and silicon wafers, $0.22 per watt for solar cells, and $0.38 per watt for solar modules.

Polysilicon is a high-purity silicon material that serves as the upstream raw material for the semiconductor and solar industries' supply chain. Manufacturers first produce it into silicon wafers, then process it into solar cells, and finally assemble it into solar modules.
Following the news, US solar manufacturers' stock prices surged. The largest US solar manufacturer, First Solar (FSLR-US), rose by 8%, while T1 Energy (TE-US) rose by 6.3%.
Trump's move is primarily aimed at China, hoping to support the development of domestic polysilicon and related products in the US, establishing a complete US solar supply chain.

The US was a major polysilicon producer in the early to mid-2000s, but Chinese companies rapidly rose to prominence, becoming the world's largest supplier by the end of the 2010s. Over the past decade, the US has been trying to rebuild its solar manufacturing capabilities, but with limited success.

In recent years, the US has repeatedly imposed anti-dumping and countervailing duties on solar equipment from China and some Southeast Asian countries, accusing some overseas companies of evading tariffs by transferring production.

However, the new tariffs may also increase the cost of solar modules, putting additional pressure on renewable energy developers who already face the cancellation of federal subsidies and the Trump administration's pro-fossil fuel policies.
Trump also called for the establishment of an investment incentive mechanism to encourage companies to set up polysilicon and related product factories in the US.

According to the executive order, the Commerce Secretary can sign individual investment agreements with companies, providing investment incentives. Companies that propose 'onshoring' plans and are approved can also be exempt from some of the new tariffs on production equipment and raw materials.

Jon Toomey, chairman of the 'Coalition for a Prosperous America,' said, 'This is the first time the US has protected the entire solar supply chain through a single policy, while also rewarding companies that invest in the US, and it's an important step in strengthening the domestic semiconductor supply chain.'

However, the delay in implementing the new measures until December has sparked discontent among some US manufacturers, who fear it will give renewable energy developers time to import cheap products and build up tax-free inventories.
Trump stated in the announcement that the government will continue to monitor trade flows and take restrictive measures if companies are found to be stockpiling polysilicon or related products.

items.title: 川普再聚焦疫苗與自閉症 傳最快下週發布行政命令 醫界憂再掀科學爭議
items.title_en: Trump Refocuses on Vaccine‑Autism Issue, Fastest Possible Executive Order Next Week Raises Medical Community Concerns
paras: 美國川普政府正考慮最快於下週發布一項與疫苗及自閉症有關的行政命令，顯示白宮可能進一步推動相關政策。根據《彭博》引述知情人士報導，此舉源自總統川普希望政府採取更多行動，但目前行政命令內容仍未定案，發布時程也仍可能調整。
截至目前，美國衛生與公共服務部 (HHS) 尚未回應相關報導，白宮也未正式證實行政命令內容。
近一年來，川普多次公開質疑疫苗與自閉症之間的關聯，並曾聲稱兒童疫苗及孕婦使用止痛藥 Tylenol(乙醯胺酚)可能與自閉症有關。然而，相關說法並未獲主流科學研究支持。美國疾病管制與預防中心 (CDC)、世界衛生組織(WHO) 及多項大型流行病學研究均指出，目前沒有可信科學證據證明兒童疫苗會導致自閉症。
市場也關注，美國衛生部長 Robert F. Kennedy Jr. 未來是否將扮演更重要角色。Kennedy 長期對疫苗安全性抱持質疑立場，今年 1 月重新改組負責制定全國自閉症政策建議的聯邦委員會，一口氣任命 21 名新成員，其中部分人士曾公開支持疫苗可能與自閉症有關的未經證實理論，引發醫學界關切。
事實上，川普政府今年以來已多次調整疫苗政策。今年 5 月，川普簽署行政命令，要求 CDC 及其疫苗諮詢委員會重新檢討美國兒童疫苗建議時程，並參考其他已開發國家的疫苗接種制度，希望調整美國核心兒童疫苗建議。白宮當時表示，此舉是為了建立「符合最佳科學證據」的疫苗政策，但相關措施仍引發醫學界不同意見。
不過，Kennedy 推動的部分疫苗政策今年 3 月已遭法院阻止。聯邦法院裁定，暫停其大幅修改兒童疫苗建議及重組 CDC 疫苗顧問委員會的部分措施，使行政部門推動相關改革受到法律限制。
近期美國媒體也陸續披露，川普持續要求 Kennedy 加強調查疫苗與自閉症議題。《華爾街日報》日前報導，川普今年 5 月曾親自要求 Kennedy 進一步研究兩者是否存在關聯，並希望重新檢討兒童疫苗接種建議，即使白宮部分政治幕僚原本希望在期中選舉前淡化疫苗議題。
專家指出，自閉症成因相當複雜，目前研究認為主要與遺傳及多重環境因素有關，但尚未找到單一原因。過去數十年，多項涵蓋數百萬名兒童的大型研究皆未發現兒童疫苗與自閉症存在因果關係。近期亦有醫學期刊指出，部分曾被引用支持疫苗與自閉症相關性的研究，因研究方法存在重大缺陷，已遭撤稿或重新審查。
分析人士認為，若白宮最終發布新的行政命令，勢必再度引發美國公共衛生政策、疫苗安全及科學證據之間的激烈辯論，也可能對 CDC 未來疫苗建議、自閉症研究方向及美國疫苗接種政策帶來新的影響。
paras_en: The Trump administration is reportedly considering issuing an executive order next week that would address vaccines and autism, indicating the White House may push related policies further. According to Bloomberg, citing informed sources, the move stems from President Trump’s desire for the government to take more action, though the order’s exact content remains undecided and the timeline could still shift.
To date, the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) has not responded to the reports, and the White House has not formally confirmed the order’s details.

Over the past year, Trump has repeatedly publicly questioned a link between vaccines and autism, even claiming that childhood vaccines and the pain reliever Tylenol (acetaminophen) used by pregnant women might be associated with autism. However, these claims lack support from mainstream scientific research. The CDC, WHO and numerous large‑scale epidemiological studies all state there is no credible scientific evidence that childhood vaccines cause autism.

The market is also watching whether Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. will assume a larger role. Kennedy has long cast doubt on vaccine safety and, in January, reshuffled the federal advisory committee that drafts national autism policy, appointing 21 new members, some of whom have publicly endorsed unverified theories linking vaccines to autism, prompting concern from the medical community.

In fact, the Trump administration has already altered vaccine policy several times this year. In May, Trump signed an executive order directing the CDC and its vaccine advisory committee to re‑examine the timing of U.S. childhood vaccine recommendations and to consider vaccination schedules used in other developed nations, aiming to revise core U.S. pediatric vaccine guidance. The White House said the move was intended to create a vaccine policy “aligned with the best scientific evidence,” though it has sparked dissent among health professionals.

However, parts of the vaccine policy championed by Kennedy were blocked by a court in March. A federal judge halted the sweeping changes to childhood vaccine recommendations and the restructuring of the CDC’s vaccine advisory panel, placing legal limits on the administration’s reform efforts.

Recent U.S. media reports reveal that Trump continues to press Kennedy to intensify investigations into the vaccine‑autism issue. The Wall Street Journal reported that in May Trump personally asked Kennedy to study whether a link exists and to revisit childhood vaccine recommendations, even as some White House aides had hoped to downplay the vaccine debate before the mid‑term elections.

Experts note that autism’s causes are highly complex, with current research pointing to genetic and multiple environmental factors rather than a single cause. Decades of large‑scale studies involving millions of children have found no causal relationship between vaccines and autism. Recent medical journals have also highlighted that some studies once cited as evidence for a vaccine‑autism link contained serious methodological flaws and have been retracted or reassessed.

Analysts say that if the White House ultimately issues a new executive order, it will likely reignite fierce debate over U.S. public‑health policy, vaccine safety and scientific evidence, and could affect future CDC vaccine guidance, autism research directions and America’s overall vaccination strategy.

items.title: 與OpenAI路線分道揚鑣！輝達低調組建AI安全團隊 押注開放權重模型
items.title_en: Diverging from OpenAI’s Path! Nvidia Quietly Forms AI Safety Team, Betting on Open-Weight Models
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，輝達正秘密籌組全新 AI 安全與網路工程團隊，強化開放權重模型時代的防禦縱深。
《Business Insider》週四報導指出，上月底一批招聘資訊首度曝光上述團隊，職缺涵蓋傑出工程師 (創始技術負責人)、安全研究工程師、評估工程師與資深經理，任務包括對尚未部署的 AI 智能體進行安全評估，並開發利用 AI 自動修復軟體漏洞的工具。
輝達在職缺描述中強調，團隊秉持「堅定信念」：開放權重、技術透明度與廣泛科學審查，是美國維持 AI 領先地位與強化網路防禦的基石。
此舉凸顯輝達在押注開放權重模型與自主智能體的同時，將 AI 安全提升至核心戰略。開放權重模型公開決定模型運行的訓練參數，但訓練數據與原始碼仍可保持封閉。
近月以來，輝達頻頻為開放模型站台，與 OpenAI、Anthropic 的閉源路線形成鮮明對照。
輝達執行長黃仁勳上月首度在 X 平台轉發公開信呼籲美國決策官員支持開放模型，直言開放能提高 AI 安全性並鞏固網路防線。
隨著 AI 從對話聊天機器人進化為可讀取企業敏感數據、調用工具並執行現實任務的智能體，企業對系統的信任度將決定普及速度。
分析人士指出，輝達此番組建專職安全團隊，既是為自家 GPU 生態護航，也是在 Agentic AI 爆發前夜，搶先卡位「安全即護城河」的產業標準制定權。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that Nvidia is secretly assembling a brand‑new AI safety and network engineering team to deepen defenses in the era of open‑weight models.

Business Insider reported on Thursday that a batch of job postings first surfaced at the end of last month for the team, covering roles such as distinguished engineer (founding technical lead), security research engineer, evaluation engineer and senior manager, with tasks that include safety assessments of yet‑to‑be‑deployed AI agents and development of tools that use AI to automatically patch software vulnerabilities.

In the job descriptions Nvidia stresses that the team operates under a “firm belief”: open weights, technical transparency and broad scientific review are the foundation for the United States to maintain AI leadership and strengthen cyber‑defense.

The move highlights that while Nvidia backs open‑weight models and autonomous agents, it is elevating AI safety to a core strategic priority. Open‑weight models make the training parameters that govern model behavior public, while the training data and source code can remain closed.
In recent months Nvidia has repeatedly championed open models, drawing a sharp contrast to the closed‑source approaches of OpenAI and Anthropic.

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang last month for the first time retweeted an open letter on X urging U.S. policymakers to support open models, stating that openness can improve AI safety and reinforce cyber defenses.
As AI evolves from chat‑based bots to agents that can read sensitive corporate data, invoke tools and perform real‑world tasks, corporate trust in the systems will dictate the speed of adoption.

Analysts say Nvidia’s creation of a dedicated safety team not only protects its own GPU ecosystem but also positions the company to set industry standards—treating safety as a moat—on the eve of an Agentic AI boom.

items.title: 土耳其、沙國、巴基斯坦將簽聯合防務協議 中東安全合作再升級
items.title_en: Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan to Sign Joint Defense Agreement, Raising Middle East Security Cooperation
paras: 根據兩名直接了解協議內容的區域消息人士透露，土耳其、沙烏地阿拉伯與巴基斯坦將於 8 日在沙烏地阿拉伯簽署一項聯合防務協議，象徵三國軍事合作進一步深化。在伊朗戰爭持續影響中東安全情勢、紅海與波斯灣緊張局勢未解之際，此舉被視為區域安全合作的重要里程碑。
截至目前，各方尚未公開協議具體內容，消息人士也未透露合作範圍、軍事承諾或執行機制。不過，協議預料將進一步提升三國在國防、情報交換、聯合演訓及區域安全事務上的合作程度。
分析人士指出，此次簽署時機正值中東安全局勢持續動盪。近期沙烏地阿拉伯與伊朗支持勢力之間緊張情勢升高，紅海與波斯灣航運安全受到衝擊，促使區域國家加快強化防衛合作，以因應能源設施、港口及海上航道面臨的安全風險。
巴基斯坦總理夏巴茲．夏立夫 (Shehbaz Sharif) 已率領高層代表團抵達吉達展開為期三天訪問，同行成員包括陸軍元帥阿西姆．穆尼爾 (Asim Munir) 等軍方高層。外界預期，雙方將討論軍事合作、區域安全及戰略夥伴關係等議題，而此次三方防務協議也將成為訪問的重要成果之一。
沙烏地阿拉伯與巴基斯坦近年軍事合作持續深化。路透社先前曾獨家披露，巴基斯坦於今年伊朗戰爭期間，依據雙方去年簽署的共同防禦協議，向沙國部署約 8,000 名官兵、一個戰鬥機中隊、防空系統及無人機等戰力，以協助保護沙國安全。消息人士指出，雙方保密協議甚至保留在必要時進一步擴大兵力部署的可能性。
此外，巴基斯坦近期也積極與其他波斯灣國家討論擴大安全合作，包括與科威特洽談新的防務合作架構，顯示伊斯蘭馬巴德正逐步擴展其在中東的安全角色，同時維持其在區域衝突中的外交斡旋地位。
市場人士認為，若土耳其、沙烏地阿拉伯與巴基斯坦正式建立新的三邊防務合作機制，將進一步強化三國在區域安全事務中的協調能力，也可能對中東未來的軍事合作架構及地緣政治平衡帶來深遠影響。不過，在協議正式公布前，其法律約束力、合作範圍及是否涉及共同防禦義務，仍有待官方進一步說明。
paras_en: According to two regional sources with direct knowledge of the agreement, Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan will sign a joint defense pact on the 8th in Saudi Arabia, symbolising a deepening of military cooperation among the three nations. With the ongoing Iran war continuing to affect Middle East security and tensions in the Red Sea and Persian Gulf unresolved, the move is seen as a major milestone in regional security cooperation.

So far, the parties have not disclosed the specific contents of the agreement, and the sources did not reveal the scope of cooperation, military commitments or implementation mechanisms. However, the pact is expected to further boost cooperation among the three countries in defence, intelligence sharing, joint exercises and regional security matters.

Analysts note that the timing of the signing comes as Middle East security remains volatile. Recent heightened tensions between Saudi Arabia and Iran‑aligned forces have impacted shipping safety in the Red Sea and Persian Gulf, prompting regional states to accelerate defence cooperation to address security risks to energy facilities, ports and sea lanes.

Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has led a senior delegation to Jeddah for a three‑day visit, accompanied by senior military officials including Army Chief Asim Munir. Observers expect discussions on military cooperation, regional security and strategic partnership, and the trilateral defence agreement is expected to be a key outcome of the visit.

Saudi‑Pakistani military cooperation has been deepening in recent years. Reuters previously disclosed that during this year’s Iran war, Pakistan, under a mutual defence pact signed last year, deployed about 8,000 troops, a fighter squadron, air‑defence systems and drones to Saudi Arabia to help protect its security. Sources say the confidentiality agreement even leaves open the possibility of further force deployments if needed.

In addition, Pakistan has recently been actively discussing expanded security cooperation with other Gulf states, including talks with Kuwait on a new defence cooperation framework, showing that Islamabad is gradually expanding its security role in the Middle East while maintaining its diplomatic mediation position in regional conflicts.

Market observers believe that if Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan formally establish a new trilateral defence cooperation mechanism, it will enhance the three countries’ coordination on regional security issues and could have far‑reaching effects on the future military cooperation architecture and geopolitical balance in the Middle East. However, until the agreement is officially released, its legal binding force, scope of cooperation and whether it entails mutual defence obligations remain to be clarified by the authorities.

items.title: Fed穆薩林挺升息！不應為AI生產力容忍高通膨
items.title_en: Fed Musalem Pushes Rate Hike! Should Not Tolerate High Inflation for AI‑Driven Productivity
paras: 聖路易聯邦準備銀行總裁穆薩林 (Alberto Musalem) 周四 (5 日) 加入多名官員支持 7 月升息的行列，表示在當前環境下，貨幣政策的首要任務是對潛在通膨形成實質的抑制效果，而非容忍當前較高的通膨，只為追求未來生產力成長。
聯準會 (Fed) 在 7 月 28 日至 29 日會議決議維持利率不變，但有三位決策官員投下反對票，主張應升息。另有多位官員近期也表示，若不及早採取行動，通膨恐將更加頑強，Fed 未來可能必須升息。
穆薩林今年沒有聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 投票權，但他表示自己在 7 月會議上主張將聯邦基金利率調高 1 碼 (25 個基點)。他也表示，會後美國公債遭拋售，再次凸顯維持 Fed 公信力的重要性。
穆薩林指出，支持升息的主要原因是，如果貨幣政策維持目前水準，未來一年左右通膨持續高於 Fed 2% 目標的機率相當高。他還表示，現在就採取行動的另一個理由是，「提早進行循序漸進的小幅升息，比日後被迫採取更劇烈的利率調整，更不具干擾性、成本也更低。」

AI 有助生產力 但不能拿來當容忍通膨的理由

部分經濟學家及 Fed 主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 認為，人工智慧 (AI) 有望提升生產力，並在長期紓解通膨壓力。不過，華許在 7 月會後坦言，相關效益何時顯現仍具高度不確定性。
穆薩林表示，具限制性的貨幣政策雖然可能拖慢創新及生產力成長，但 Fed 不能把市場對其控制通膨能力的信心視為理所當然。
他警告：「如果市場認為央行願意容忍高於目標的通膨，只因寄望未來生產力大幅提升，將危及通膨預期的錨定。一旦公信力流失，重建代價將非常高。」
美國本周五將公布最新就業報告，下周則將公布新一輪通膨數據。穆薩林表示，美國經濟近月來依然展現韌性，勞動市場已趨於穩定，就業人數持續穩健成長，失業率也維持在接近長期均衡水準。
paras_en: St. Louis Federal Reserve Bank President Alberto Musalem joined several officials on Thursday (the 5th) in supporting a July rate hike, saying that in the current environment the primary task of monetary policy is to exert a real restraining effect on underlying inflation rather than tolerate the presently elevated inflation simply to chase future productivity growth.

The Fed’s July 28‑29 meeting resolved to keep rates unchanged, but three voting members cast dissenting votes urging a hike. Several other officials have recently warned that without early action inflation could become more entrenched, forcing the Fed to raise rates later.

Musalem does not have a vote on this year’s Federal Open Market Committee, yet he said he advocated a one‑point (25‑basis‑point) increase in the federal funds rate at the July meeting. He also noted that Treasury bonds were sold off after the meeting, underscoring the importance of preserving the Fed’s credibility.

He explained that the main reason to support a hike is that, if policy stays at current levels, the odds are high that inflation will remain above the Fed’s 2% target for roughly the next year. He added that acting now with a modest, gradual increase is less disruptive and cheaper than being forced later to make a more aggressive adjustment.

AI can boost productivity but should not be used as a justification for tolerating inflation. Some economists and former Fed chair Kevin Warsh see AI as a potential long‑term productivity driver that could ease inflation pressures, but Warsh admitted after the July meeting that the timing of any benefits remains highly uncertain.
Musalem said that while restrictive policy may slow innovation and productivity growth, the Fed cannot take market confidence in its inflation‑controlling ability for granted.

He warned, “If the market believes the central bank will tolerate inflation above target because it hopes for a big future productivity jump, it will jeopardize the anchoring of inflation expectations. Once credibility is lost, the cost of rebuilding it will be very high.”

The United States will release its latest jobs report on Friday and new inflation data next week. Musalem noted that the U.S. economy has remained resilient in recent months, the labor market has stabilized, employment continues to grow steadily, and the unemployment rate remains near its long‑term equilibrium level.

items.title: 預測平台Kalshi交易者：標普年底有很高機率衝破8000點 站上8200機率達三分之一

paras: 預測交易平台 Kalshi 最新合約顯示，交易員押注標普 500 指數今年收盤站上 8000 點的機率約 66%。
Kalshi 合約以 Google Finance 收盤價結算，投機者另押注今年觸及 8200 點機率約 33%。
驅動標普近日連漲的催化劑包括美伊緊張降溫、美企 Q2 財報普遍擊敗預期及 Leopold Aschenbrenner 旗下「態勢感知基金」瀕臨清算釋出再配置資金。
市場前兩個月曾大幅減持 AI 成長股，指數靠輪動至金融、工業與公用事業掩蓋內部分化，但 AI 算力鏈回穩後，寬基 ETF 再次由科技權值帶頭。
多數賣方不把 6-7 月整理視為 AI 牛市終結。Truist 首席市場策略師 Keith Lerner 直言，企業獲利上修、美國經濟具韌性、市場廣度改善，「這種環境通常不是牛市尾聲」。
Kalshi 的 66% 機率雖非機構共識，但反映散戶與量化資金對「獲利驅動 + 利率回落」組合的定價。若 10 年期美債殖利率穩住 4.7% 下方、聯準會 (Fed) 年內不重啟升息，8000 點將從情緒目標變成可結算路徑。
paras_en: The latest contract on the prediction‑trading platform Kalshi shows that traders are betting the probability that the S&P 500 will close above 8,000 points this year is about 66%.
Kalshi contracts settle at the Google Finance closing price, and speculators also wager the probability of hitting 8,200 points this year at roughly 33%.

Catalysts driving the recent rally in the S&P include a cooling of U.S.–Iran tensions, U.S. companies' Q2 earnings generally beating expectations, and the near‑liquidation of Leopold Aschenbrenner’s “Situational Awareness Fund,” which is releasing capital for reallocation.

In the first two months, the market sharply reduced exposure to AI growth stocks, with the index rotating into financials, industrials and utilities to mask internal divergence, but after the AI compute chain stabilized, broad‑based ETFs again led the rally with tech weighting.

Most sell‑side analysts do not view the June‑July consolidation as the end of the AI bull market. Truist chief market strategist Keith Lerner said outright that corporate profit upgrades, a resilient U.S. economy, and improving market breadth mean “this kind of environment is usually not the tail end of a bull market.”

Kalshi’s 66% probability is not an institutional consensus, but it reflects retail and quantitative capital pricing the “profit‑driven + rate‑cut” combination. If the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield holds below 4.7% and the Fed does not restart rate hikes this year, 8,000 points will shift from a sentiment target to a realizable path.

items.title: 川普祭232條款！多晶矽產品課15%關稅並設最低進口價 12月生效
items.title_en: Trump Signs 232 Provisions! 15% Tariff on Polysilicon Products and Minimum Import Price of $12 per Kilogram to Take Effect in December
paras: 美國總統川普周四 (6 日) 簽署公告，依據《1962 年貿易擴張法》第 232 條，對進口多晶矽 (polysilicon) 衍生產品課徵 15% 關稅，並同步設立最低進口價格，理由是美國過度依賴外國供應已危及國家安全。
新措施將於 12 月 4 日生效。根據公告，進口多晶矽衍生產品，包括矽晶圓、太陽能電池及太陽能模組等，都將適用於 15% 關稅。
公告中也指出，多晶矽最低進口價格訂為每公斤 21 美元，多晶矽錠與矽晶圓每公斤 100 美元，太陽能電池每瓦 0.22 美元，太陽能模組每瓦 0.38 美元。
多晶矽是一種超高純度矽材料，為半導體與太陽能產業供應鏈最上游原料。製造商先將其製成矽晶圓，再加工為太陽能電池，最後組裝成太陽能模組。
受消息激勵，美國太陽能製造商盤後股價走高。美國最大太陽能製造商第一太陽能 (First Solar)(FSLR-US) 一度大漲 8%，T1 Energy(TE-US)一度漲 6.3%。
川普此舉主要針對中國競爭，希望扶植美國本土多晶矽及相關產品生產，建立完整的美國太陽能供應鏈。
美國在 2000 年代初期至中期曾是全球主要多晶矽生產國，但後來中國企業快速崛起，至 2010 年代末已成為全球最大供應者。這十多年來，美國一直試圖重建美國的太陽能製造能力，但成效有限。
近年來，美國已多次對中國及部分東南亞國家的太陽能設備祭出反傾銷及反補貼措施，並指控部分海外業者藉由轉移生產地規避關稅。
不過，新關稅也可能推高太陽能模組成本，對原本已面臨聯邦補貼取消、且須因應川普政府偏向支持化石燃料政策的再生能源開發商，帶來新的壓力。

提供投資誘因 鼓勵回流美國設廠

川普也要求商務部建立投資獎勵機制，鼓勵企業赴美設立多晶矽及衍生產品工廠。
根據行政命令，商務部長可與企業簽訂個別投資協議，提供投資誘因。提出「回流美國」(onshoring) 計畫且獲批准的企業，還可免除部分生產設備及原料的新增關稅。
「繁榮美國聯盟」(Coalition for a Prosperous America) 主席 Jon Toomey 說：「這是美國首次透過單一政策保護整個太陽能供應鏈，同時獎勵在美投資設廠企業，也是強化本土半導體供應鏈的重要一步。」
不過，新措施延至 12 月才實施，引發部分美國製造商不滿。他們認為，這將讓再生能源開發商有時間大量進口低價產品並建立免稅庫存。
對此川普在公告中表示，政府將持續監控貿易流向，若發現企業藉機囤積多晶矽或相關產品，將採取限制措施。
paras_en: US President Trump signed an announcement on Thursday (6th) to impose a 15% tariff on imported polysilicon-derived products, including silicon wafers, solar cells, and solar modules, under Section 232 of the 1962 Trade Expansion Act, citing national security concerns due to over-reliance on foreign suppliers.

The new measures will take effect on December 4th. According to the announcement, all polysilicon-derived products, including silicon wafers, solar cells, and solar modules, will be subject to a 15% tariff.

The announcement also sets a minimum import price of $21 per kilogram for polysilicon, $100 per kilogram for polysilicon ingots and silicon wafers, $0.22 per watt for solar cells, and $0.38 per watt for solar modules.

Polysilicon is a high-purity silicon material that serves as the upstream raw material for the semiconductor and solar industries' supply chain. Manufacturers first produce it into silicon wafers, then process it into solar cells, and finally assemble it into solar modules.
Following the news, US solar manufacturers' stock prices surged. The largest US solar manufacturer, First Solar (FSLR-US), rose by 8%, while T1 Energy (TE-US) rose by 6.3%.
Trump's move is primarily aimed at China, hoping to support the development of domestic polysilicon and related products in the US, establishing a complete US solar supply chain.

The US was a major polysilicon producer in the early to mid-2000s, but Chinese companies rapidly rose to prominence, becoming the world's largest supplier by the end of the 2010s. Over the past decade, the US has been trying to rebuild its solar manufacturing capabilities, but with limited success.

In recent years, the US has repeatedly imposed anti-dumping and countervailing duties on solar equipment from China and some Southeast Asian countries, accusing some overseas companies of evading tariffs by transferring production.

However, the new tariffs may also increase the cost of solar modules, putting additional pressure on renewable energy developers who already face the cancellation of federal subsidies and the Trump administration's pro-fossil fuel policies.
Trump also called for the establishment of an investment incentive mechanism to encourage companies to set up polysilicon and related product factories in the US.

According to the executive order, the Commerce Secretary can sign individual investment agreements with companies, providing investment incentives. Companies that propose 'onshoring' plans and are approved can also be exempt from some of the new tariffs on production equipment and raw materials.

Jon Toomey, chairman of the 'Coalition for a Prosperous America,' said, 'This is the first time the US has protected the entire solar supply chain through a single policy, while also rewarding companies that invest in the US, and it's an important step in strengthening the domestic semiconductor supply chain.'

However, the delay in implementing the new measures until December has sparked discontent among some US manufacturers, who fear it will give renewable energy developers time to import cheap products and build up tax-free inventories.
Trump stated in the announcement that the government will continue to monitor trade flows and take restrictive measures if companies are found to be stockpiling polysilicon or related products.

items.title: 與OpenAI路線分道揚鑣！輝達低調組建AI安全團隊 押注開放權重模型
items.title_en: Diverging from OpenAI’s Path! Nvidia Quietly Forms AI Safety Team, Betting on Open-Weight Models
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，輝達正秘密籌組全新 AI 安全與網路工程團隊，強化開放權重模型時代的防禦縱深。
《Business Insider》週四報導指出，上月底一批招聘資訊首度曝光上述團隊，職缺涵蓋傑出工程師 (創始技術負責人)、安全研究工程師、評估工程師與資深經理，任務包括對尚未部署的 AI 智能體進行安全評估，並開發利用 AI 自動修復軟體漏洞的工具。
輝達在職缺描述中強調，團隊秉持「堅定信念」：開放權重、技術透明度與廣泛科學審查，是美國維持 AI 領先地位與強化網路防禦的基石。
此舉凸顯輝達在押注開放權重模型與自主智能體的同時，將 AI 安全提升至核心戰略。開放權重模型公開決定模型運行的訓練參數，但訓練數據與原始碼仍可保持封閉。
近月以來，輝達頻頻為開放模型站台，與 OpenAI、Anthropic 的閉源路線形成鮮明對照。
輝達執行長黃仁勳上月首度在 X 平台轉發公開信呼籲美國決策官員支持開放模型，直言開放能提高 AI 安全性並鞏固網路防線。
隨著 AI 從對話聊天機器人進化為可讀取企業敏感數據、調用工具並執行現實任務的智能體，企業對系統的信任度將決定普及速度。
分析人士指出，輝達此番組建專職安全團隊，既是為自家 GPU 生態護航，也是在 Agentic AI 爆發前夜，搶先卡位「安全即護城河」的產業標準制定權。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that Nvidia is secretly assembling a brand‑new AI safety and network engineering team to deepen defenses in the era of open‑weight models.

Business Insider reported on Thursday that a batch of job postings first surfaced at the end of last month for the team, covering roles such as distinguished engineer (founding technical lead), security research engineer, evaluation engineer and senior manager, with tasks that include safety assessments of yet‑to‑be‑deployed AI agents and development of tools that use AI to automatically patch software vulnerabilities.

In the job descriptions Nvidia stresses that the team operates under a “firm belief”: open weights, technical transparency and broad scientific review are the foundation for the United States to maintain AI leadership and strengthen cyber‑defense.

The move highlights that while Nvidia backs open‑weight models and autonomous agents, it is elevating AI safety to a core strategic priority. Open‑weight models make the training parameters that govern model behavior public, while the training data and source code can remain closed.
In recent months Nvidia has repeatedly championed open models, drawing a sharp contrast to the closed‑source approaches of OpenAI and Anthropic.

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang last month for the first time retweeted an open letter on X urging U.S. policymakers to support open models, stating that openness can improve AI safety and reinforce cyber defenses.
As AI evolves from chat‑based bots to agents that can read sensitive corporate data, invoke tools and perform real‑world tasks, corporate trust in the systems will dictate the speed of adoption.

Analysts say Nvidia’s creation of a dedicated safety team not only protects its own GPU ecosystem but also positions the company to set industry standards—treating safety as a moat—on the eve of an Agentic AI boom.

items.title: 美國禁止鎢廢料及電池廢棄物出口 強化本土關鍵礦產供應鏈
items.title_en: U.S. Bans Export of Tungsten Waste and Battery Waste to Strengthen Domestic Critical Mineral Supply Chain
paras: 《路透社》報導，美國商務部周四 (6 日) 表示，將禁止鎢廢料及電池廢棄物出口，以推動美國國內回收產業發展，並提升關鍵礦產生產力。
這項措施符合市場預期。美國總統川普上周已簽署行政命令，授權聯邦官員限制含有高價值關鍵礦產的廢料出口至中國及其他國家。
這項命令禁止出口的項目包括俗稱「黑粉」的材料，即經粉碎處理的鋰離子電池，以及含有鎢的廢料。鎢廣泛用於提高鋼材硬度，也是國防工業的重要材料。
此舉是美國降低對中國依賴的最新措施之一。中國目前主導全球關鍵礦產加工，相關礦物廣泛應用於電動車電池、武器系統等產品。
隨著美中在關鍵礦產供應上的競爭升溫，華府近年持續透過出口管制、關稅及國內補助等政策，重建美國本土供應鏈。
根據刊登於「聯邦公報」(Federal Register) 的命令，美國商務部工業與安全局表示，新規將於 8 月 27 日生效，實施期限為一年。
華府智庫 SAFE 關鍵礦產政策經理 Zubeyde Oysul 表示，「很高興看到政府認識到，從廢料中回收可再利用的關鍵材料的重要性。」
根據命令，只有企業能證明將遭受「過度困難」或「無法彌補的損害」時，政府才可能逐案核發豁免。
環境組織 Basel Action Network 數據顯示，美國每月出口近 3.3 萬公噸電子廢棄物及其他廢料，其中許多都含有可回收再利用的關鍵礦產。
這類出口長期以來引發美國回收業者不滿。業界認為，若能將這些材料留在國內，將有助於美國提升關鍵礦產生產能力。
不過，美國目前仍缺乏足夠的回收產能，無法處理所有產生的廢料。且過去 18 個月來，多家回收企業也面臨經營困境，包括 Li-Cycle(LICYQ-US) 及 Ascend Elements 均已聲請破產。
私人鎢回收公司 Amermin 對這項禁令表示歡迎，但也認為，美國仍須進一步提升國內廢料處理能力。
Amermin 執行長 Ryan McAdams 表示，「這項禁令只是權宜之計。它能替我們爭取更多時間，但我們仍必須開始在美國本土建立相關基礎設施。」
McAdams 透露，Amermin 去年獲得美國能源部 1,150 萬美元補助，但資金至今尚未撥付。他表示，若當時能取得這筆資金，公司商業化回收工廠至少可提前六個月營運。
paras_en: Reuters reported that the U.S. Department of Commerce on Thursday (the 6th) announced a ban on the export of tungsten waste and battery waste to promote the development of domestic recycling industries and boost productivity of critical minerals.

The move aligns with market expectations. President Trump signed an executive order last week authorizing federal officials to restrict the export of waste containing high‑value critical minerals to China and other countries.

The order bars the export of material colloquially known as “black powder,” which is crushed lithium‑ion battery waste, as well as waste containing tungsten. Tungsten is widely used to harden steel and is a key material for the defense industry.

The step is one of the latest U.S. measures to reduce reliance on China, which currently dominates global processing of critical minerals used in electric‑vehicle batteries, weapon systems and other products.
As competition with China over critical‑mineral supplies heats up, Washington has in recent years been rebuilding the domestic supply chain through export controls, tariffs and domestic subsidies.
According to the order published in the Federal Register, the Commerce Department’s Bureau of Industry and Security said the new rule will take effect on August 27 and will be in force for one year.
SAFE think‑tank critical‑minerals policy manager Zubeyde Oysul said, “We’re pleased to see the government recognize the importance of recovering reusable critical materials from waste.”
The order allows exemptions only on a case‑by‑case basis when a company can demonstrate it would face “excessive difficulty” or “irreparable harm” without the export.
Data from the Basel Action Network shows the United States exports roughly 33,000 metric tons of electronic waste and other waste each month, much of which contains recoverable critical minerals.
Such exports have long drawn complaints from U.S. recyclers, who argue that keeping these materials domestically would help boost the country’s critical‑mineral production capacity.

However, the United States still lacks sufficient recycling capacity to handle all generated waste, and over the past 18 months several recyclers, including Li‑Cycle (LICYQ‑US) and Ascend Elements, have filed for bankruptcy.
Private tungsten recycler Amermin welcomed the ban but said the U.S. still needs to further improve its domestic waste‑processing capabilities.
Amermin CEO Ryan McAdams said, “The ban is only a stopgap. It buys us more time, but we still have to start building the necessary infrastructure here in the United States.”

McAdams disclosed that Amermin received a $11.5 million grant from the U.S. Department of Energy last year, but the funds have not yet been disbursed. He said that if the money had been received, the company’s commercial recycling plant could have been operational at least six months earlier.

items.title: SanDisk財測不如預期跌逾6% 記憶體配給將延至2027年後
items.title_en: SanDisk Forecast Misses Expectations, Shares Drop Over 6% as Memory Allocation Extends Past 2027
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，SanDisk(SNDK-US)股價周四 (6 日) 重挫 6.8%，這家快閃記憶體與儲存裝置製造商公布的 2027 會計年度第一季營收財測低於分析師預期。
SanDisk 預估，第一季營收將介於 103 億至 108 億美元，低於分析師預估的 111.6 億美元。雖然上季毛利率創下 84.6% 歷史新高，但公司對 2027 年的毛利率展望為 83% 至 85%。
上季調整後每股盈餘 (EPS) 為 39.25 美元，優於市場預估的 34.37 美元。公司預估本季調整後 EPS 將介於 44 至 46 美元，市場預估為 45.58 美元。
SanDisk 2026 會計年度第四季營收達 87.9 億美元，高於華爾街預估的 86.4 億美元。公司表示，營收成長約有三分之一來自出貨量增加，另外三分之二來自售價提升。
管理層指出，目前客戶需求仍高於供給，因此預期記憶體位元配給制度將持續至 2027 年以後。換言之，公司仍將持續對客戶分配記憶體供應。
管理層表示，自 4 月財報發布以來，公司持續推動長期合約新商業模式 (NBM)，期間已新增 3 家新客戶，並擴大 2 項既有合作，反映長期需求依然強勁。這些合約最長可達 5 年，平均合約期間超過 4 年。
SanDisk 財務長 Luis Visoso 表示，「以最低價格計算，我們目前已簽署的所有 NBM 合約，預計將帶來至少 939 億美元的營收。我們相信實際營收將高於這個最低標準。」
至於未納入 NBM 合約的業務，其產品價格仍將隨市場行情波動。
SanDisk 於 2025 年 2 月自威騰電子 (Western Digital)(WDC-US) 分拆上市。隨著記憶體與儲存設備成為 AI 基礎設施建設的重要瓶頸，公司今年成為美股表現最亮眼個股之一。
這周稍早，SanDisk 一度大漲，因公司與記憶體製造商 SK 海力士 (SKHY-US) 共同發布一項新的硬體技術藍圖，希望透過建立高速記憶體的共同標準，讓 AI 晶片運行速度更快、成本更低。雙方表示，這項合作將有助於降低資料中心成本，並加速部署先進 AI 應用。
截至目前，SanDisk 今年以來股價已大漲近 490%，也是標普 500 指數自 2026 年初以來表現最佳的成分股。
華爾街共有 25 位分析師給予買進評級、5 位給予持有評級，沒有任何分析師建議賣出，平均目標價略高於 2,400 美元。
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reported that SanDisk (SNDK-US) shares plunged 6.8% on Thursday (the 6th) after the flash memory and storage device maker posted its fiscal 2027 first‑quarter revenue forecast below analysts’ expectations.

SanDisk projects first‑quarter revenue between $10.3 billion and $10.8 billion, below the consensus estimate of $11.16 billion. Although last quarter’s gross margin hit a historic high of 84.6%, the company sees fiscal 2027 gross margins in the 83%‑85% range.

Adjusted earnings per share for the prior quarter were $39.25, beating the market’s $34.37 estimate. The company now expects adjusted EPS of $44‑$46 for the current quarter, versus the consensus of $45.58.

SanDisk’s fiscal 2026 fourth‑quarter revenue reached $8.79 billion, topping Wall Street’s $8.64 billion forecast. The company said roughly one‑third of the growth came from higher shipment volumes and two‑thirds from price increases.

Management noted that customer demand still exceeds supply, so the memory bit‑allocation regime is expected to continue beyond 2027. In other words, the company will keep allocating memory supply to customers.

Since the April earnings release, management has been advancing a new long‑term contract business model (NBM), adding three new customers and expanding two existing collaborations, indicating that long‑term demand remains strong. These contracts can run up to five years, with an average term of more than four years.

Chief Financial Officer Luis Visoso said, “At the lowest price point, all NBM contracts we have signed to date are expected to generate at least $93.9 billion in revenue. We believe actual revenue will exceed that minimum benchmark.”
Revenue from business not covered by NBM contracts will still fluctuate with market pricing.

SanDisk was spun off from Western Digital (WDC‑US) in February 2025. As memory and storage become critical bottlenecks for AI infrastructure, the company has been one of the best‑performing U.S. stocks this year.

Earlier this week SanDisk surged after it and memory maker SK Hynix (SKHY‑US) unveiled a new hardware‑technology roadmap aimed at establishing a common high‑speed memory standard to make AI chips run faster and cheaper. Both parties said the collaboration would help lower data‑center costs and accelerate deployment of advanced AI applications.
To date, SanDisk’s stock has risen nearly 490% year‑to‑date, making it the top‑performing component of the S&P 500 since the start of 2026.
Wall Street’s 25 analysts rate the stock as a buy, five as hold, and none as sell, with an average target price slightly above $2,400.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走強 避險需求升溫 殖利率上揚
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Strengthens as Hedge Demand Rises and Yields Climb
paras: 美元周四 (6 日) 走強，升至一周高點，受避險需求升溫及美國公債殖利率上揚支撐，市場同時靜待周五公布的關鍵就業數據。另一方面，日元兌美元跌破 158，為上周日本當局干預匯市以來首見。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數 (DXY) 上漲 0.3%，報 99.94，前一交易日曾跌至七周低點。
美元這周稍早一度走弱，投資人轉向股票等風險性資產，帶動華爾街在 7 月表現平淡後強勢展開 8 月行情。
此外，市場預期荷姆茲海峽 (Strait of Hormuz) 有望重新開放，也推動油價下跌，提振市場風險偏好。
不過，原油價格周四明顯反彈。媒體報導指出，伊朗與阿曼擬定的荷姆茲海峽重啟框架，將禁止美國船舶通行，直到相關賠償完成為止。
伊朗《法斯通訊社》(Fars) 引述國會議員 Alireza Salimi 報導，荷姆茲海峽方案初步文本目前正由當局審查。根據方案，在賠償完成前，美國、以色列及其他「敵對國家」船舶將不得通行這條重要航道。
《法斯通訊社》另引述伊朗外交部消息人士指出，依照方案，船舶將由靠近伊朗海岸的北側航道進入荷姆茲海峽，並由靠近阿曼海岸的南側航道離開。在特定期限後，兩側航道都將停止通行，改由中央航道取代，屆時將由伊朗負責入境管理，出境則由伊朗與阿曼共同管理。
若上述方案屬實，其中部分內容預料難以獲得華府接受。
美國總統川普本周稍早表示，由於和平協議談判取得進展，他已取消原定對伊朗發動的強力軍事攻擊，但也警告，若雙方無法達成協議，美國已「準備好採取行動」。自 2 月底戰爭爆發以來，美伊雙方持續在威脅、攻擊與讓步之間反覆交鋒。
非農就業報告公布在即
美元周四也受到市場對貨幣政策前景的不安情緒支撐。投資人拋售美國公債，推升美債殖利率。市場焦點轉向周五公布的 7 月非農就業報告，預料將成為聯準會利率走向的重要觀察指標。
本周公布的勞動市場數據表現不一。美國 6 月職缺增幅低於預期，也較 5 月放緩，7 月 ADP 民間就業新增人數同樣不及市場預期，且增幅較 6 月降溫。
另一方面，美國首次申領失業金人數已連續第三周低於 20 萬人，這種情況自 1960 年代末以來相當罕見。
整體而言，數據顯示美國勞動市場仍具韌性，也支持聯準會近期將政策重心重新放回抑制通膨。同時，中東衝突導致油價波動，改變了通膨走勢，也讓聯準會官員對未來貨幣政策方向出現分歧。
Interactive Brokers 資深經濟學家 José Torres 表示，「我預期 7 月新增就業人數將連續第四個月放緩，估計僅增加 4 萬人。勞動市場正受到供給限制影響，勞動參與率大幅下滑、勞動力規模縮減，同時薪資壓力持續升高。」
他指出，「即使失業率維持偏低，只要整體新增就業數據疲弱，就足以帶動美國公債反彈。因為一旦固定收益市場投資人開始擔心企業可能縮減人力，市場就會開始反映經濟放緩風險。」
但他也表示，「目前中東局勢仍是市場關注焦點，因此無論非農就業報告結果如何，華爾街最在意的仍是美國與伊朗之間的互動。」
日元干預後首跌破 158

貝森特周二接受 CNBC 訪問時表示，美方之所以協助日本，是因為日元若持續走弱，可能衝擊整個亞洲金融市場。
在此次干預前，日元一度跌至 1 美元兌 164 日元，創 40 年新低。
RSM US 經濟學家 Joseph Brusuelas 表示，「別搞錯了，干預措施之後，日本必須推出真正的政策改變，而這代表政策利率需要上調，才能證明這筆投入的資金是值得的。」

Meanwhile, the yen fell below 158 per dollar, the first time since Japanese authorities intervened in the market last week.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY) tracking the greenback against six major currencies rose 0.3% to 99.94, after having slipped to a seven‑week low the previous session.
The dollar had briefly weakened earlier this week as investors shifted toward equities and other risk assets, helping Wall Street launch a strong August rally after a flat July performance.
In addition, market expectations that the Strait of Hormuz may reopen helped push oil prices lower and boosted risk appetite.

However, oil prices rebounded sharply on Thursday. Media reports said that a framework for reopening the Strait of Hormuz, drafted by Iran and Oman, would bar U.S. vessels until related compensation is settled.

Iran’s Fars news agency, citing MP Alireza Salimi, reported that a preliminary text of the Hormuz plan is currently under review by authorities. Under the proposal, U.S., Israeli and other “hostile” ships would be prohibited from using the vital waterway until compensation is paid.

Fars also quoted an Iranian foreign‑ministry source saying that, according to the plan, vessels would enter the strait via the northern channel close to Iran’s coast and exit through the southern channel near Oman. After a set period, both side channels would close and be replaced by a central channel, with Iran handling inbound traffic and Iran and Oman jointly managing outbound traffic.
If the proposal is real, parts of it are expected to be difficult for Washington to accept.

U.S. President Trump said earlier this week that, because peace‑talk progress had been made, he had cancelled the planned strong military strike on Iran, but warned that the United States is “ready to act” if a deal cannot be reached. Since the war erupted at the end of February, the U.S. and Iran have repeatedly swung between threats, attacks and concessions.
Non‑farm payroll report imminent

The dollar on Thursday was also supported by market unease over the monetary‑policy outlook. Investors sold U.S. Treasuries, pushing yields higher. Attention shifted to Friday’s July non‑farm payroll report, expected to be a key gauge of the Fed’s rate trajectory.

Labor‑market data released this week were mixed. U.S. June job openings rose less than expected and slowed from May, and July ADP private‑sector employment added fewer jobs than forecast, with growth cooling versus June.
Conversely, first‑time unemployment claims in the United States fell below 200,000 for the third consecutive week, a rarity not seen since the late 1960s.

Overall, the data show that the U.S. labor market remains resilient, supporting the Fed’s recent shift back to focusing on inflation control. At the same time, Middle‑East conflict‑driven oil‑price swings have altered inflation trends and created policy‑direction splits among Fed officials.

Interactive Brokers senior economist José Torres said, “I expect July’s job additions to slow for the fourth straight month, estimating only 40,000 new jobs. The labor market is being constrained by supply‑side factors, with a sharp drop in labor‑force participation, a shrinking workforce and rising wage pressure.”

He added, “Even with a still‑low unemployment rate, weak overall job growth is enough to trigger a rebound in U.S. Treasuries, because once fixed‑income investors start fearing companies may cut staff, the market will price in slowdown risk.”
He also noted, “The Middle‑East situation remains the market’s focus, so regardless of the payroll outcome, Wall Street’s biggest concern is the interaction between the United States and Iran.”
Yen falls below 158 after intervention
Beyond the dollar, the yen remains a major market focus.
The dollar‑yen pair rose 0.4% to 158.39, the first time since Japanese authorities launched a large‑scale intervention that the rate has climbed back above 158.

U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent confirmed earlier this week that the United States has teamed up with Japan to buy yen, marking the first joint intervention since 2011 and the first direct U.S. action since 1998.
Bessent told CNBC on Tuesday that the U.S. is helping Japan because a continuously weakening yen could damage the broader Asian financial system.
Before the intervention, the yen had slipped to ¥164 per dollar, a 40‑year low.
RSM US economist Joseph Brusuelas said, “Don’t get it wrong—after the intervention Japan must enact real policy changes, meaning the policy rate needs to be raised to justify the money spent.”

items.title: Fed穆薩林挺升息！不應為AI生產力容忍高通膨
items.title_en: Fed Musalem Pushes Rate Hike! Should Not Tolerate High Inflation for AI‑Driven Productivity
paras: 聖路易聯邦準備銀行總裁穆薩林 (Alberto Musalem) 周四 (5 日) 加入多名官員支持 7 月升息的行列，表示在當前環境下，貨幣政策的首要任務是對潛在通膨形成實質的抑制效果，而非容忍當前較高的通膨，只為追求未來生產力成長。
聯準會 (Fed) 在 7 月 28 日至 29 日會議決議維持利率不變，但有三位決策官員投下反對票，主張應升息。另有多位官員近期也表示，若不及早採取行動，通膨恐將更加頑強，Fed 未來可能必須升息。
穆薩林今年沒有聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 投票權，但他表示自己在 7 月會議上主張將聯邦基金利率調高 1 碼 (25 個基點)。他也表示，會後美國公債遭拋售，再次凸顯維持 Fed 公信力的重要性。
穆薩林指出，支持升息的主要原因是，如果貨幣政策維持目前水準，未來一年左右通膨持續高於 Fed 2% 目標的機率相當高。他還表示，現在就採取行動的另一個理由是，「提早進行循序漸進的小幅升息，比日後被迫採取更劇烈的利率調整，更不具干擾性、成本也更低。」

AI 有助生產力 但不能拿來當容忍通膨的理由

部分經濟學家及 Fed 主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 認為，人工智慧 (AI) 有望提升生產力，並在長期紓解通膨壓力。不過，華許在 7 月會後坦言，相關效益何時顯現仍具高度不確定性。
穆薩林表示，具限制性的貨幣政策雖然可能拖慢創新及生產力成長，但 Fed 不能把市場對其控制通膨能力的信心視為理所當然。
他警告：「如果市場認為央行願意容忍高於目標的通膨，只因寄望未來生產力大幅提升，將危及通膨預期的錨定。一旦公信力流失，重建代價將非常高。」
美國本周五將公布最新就業報告，下周則將公布新一輪通膨數據。穆薩林表示，美國經濟近月來依然展現韌性，勞動市場已趨於穩定，就業人數持續穩健成長，失業率也維持在接近長期均衡水準。
paras_en: St. Louis Federal Reserve Bank President Alberto Musalem joined several officials on Thursday (the 5th) in supporting a July rate hike, saying that in the current environment the primary task of monetary policy is to exert a real restraining effect on underlying inflation rather than tolerate the presently elevated inflation simply to chase future productivity growth.

The Fed’s July 28‑29 meeting resolved to keep rates unchanged, but three voting members cast dissenting votes urging a hike. Several other officials have recently warned that without early action inflation could become more entrenched, forcing the Fed to raise rates later.

Musalem does not have a vote on this year’s Federal Open Market Committee, yet he said he advocated a one‑point (25‑basis‑point) increase in the federal funds rate at the July meeting. He also noted that Treasury bonds were sold off after the meeting, underscoring the importance of preserving the Fed’s credibility.

He explained that the main reason to support a hike is that, if policy stays at current levels, the odds are high that inflation will remain above the Fed’s 2% target for roughly the next year. He added that acting now with a modest, gradual increase is less disruptive and cheaper than being forced later to make a more aggressive adjustment.

AI can boost productivity but should not be used as a justification for tolerating inflation. Some economists and former Fed chair Kevin Warsh see AI as a potential long‑term productivity driver that could ease inflation pressures, but Warsh admitted after the July meeting that the timing of any benefits remains highly uncertain.
Musalem said that while restrictive policy may slow innovation and productivity growth, the Fed cannot take market confidence in its inflation‑controlling ability for granted.

He warned, “If the market believes the central bank will tolerate inflation above target because it hopes for a big future productivity jump, it will jeopardize the anchoring of inflation expectations. Once credibility is lost, the cost of rebuilding it will be very high.”

The United States will release its latest jobs report on Friday and new inflation data next week. Musalem noted that the U.S. economy has remained resilient in recent months, the labor market has stabilized, employment continues to grow steadily, and the unemployment rate remains near its long‑term equilibrium level.

paras: 預測交易平台 Kalshi 最新合約顯示，交易員押注標普 500 指數今年收盤站上 8000 點的機率約 66%。
Kalshi 合約以 Google Finance 收盤價結算，投機者另押注今年觸及 8200 點機率約 33%。
驅動標普近日連漲的催化劑包括美伊緊張降溫、美企 Q2 財報普遍擊敗預期及 Leopold Aschenbrenner 旗下「態勢感知基金」瀕臨清算釋出再配置資金。
市場前兩個月曾大幅減持 AI 成長股，指數靠輪動至金融、工業與公用事業掩蓋內部分化，但 AI 算力鏈回穩後，寬基 ETF 再次由科技權值帶頭。
多數賣方不把 6-7 月整理視為 AI 牛市終結。Truist 首席市場策略師 Keith Lerner 直言，企業獲利上修、美國經濟具韌性、市場廣度改善，「這種環境通常不是牛市尾聲」。
Kalshi 的 66% 機率雖非機構共識，但反映散戶與量化資金對「獲利驅動 + 利率回落」組合的定價。若 10 年期美債殖利率穩住 4.7% 下方、聯準會 (Fed) 年內不重啟升息，8000 點將從情緒目標變成可結算路徑。
paras_en: The latest contract on the prediction‑trading platform Kalshi shows that traders are betting the probability that the S&P 500 will close above 8,000 points this year is about 66%.
Kalshi contracts settle at the Google Finance closing price, and speculators also wager the probability of hitting 8,200 points this year at roughly 33%.

Catalysts driving the recent rally in the S&P include a cooling of U.S.–Iran tensions, U.S. companies' Q2 earnings generally beating expectations, and the near‑liquidation of Leopold Aschenbrenner’s “Situational Awareness Fund,” which is releasing capital for reallocation.

In the first two months, the market sharply reduced exposure to AI growth stocks, with the index rotating into financials, industrials and utilities to mask internal divergence, but after the AI compute chain stabilized, broad‑based ETFs again led the rally with tech weighting.

Most sell‑side analysts do not view the June‑July consolidation as the end of the AI bull market. Truist chief market strategist Keith Lerner said outright that corporate profit upgrades, a resilient U.S. economy, and improving market breadth mean “this kind of environment is usually not the tail end of a bull market.”

Kalshi’s 66% probability is not an institutional consensus, but it reflects retail and quantitative capital pricing the “profit‑driven + rate‑cut” combination. If the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield holds below 4.7% and the Fed does not restart rate hikes this year, 8,000 points will shift from a sentiment target to a realizable path.

items.title: 川普祭232條款！多晶矽產品課15%關稅並設最低進口價 12月生效
items.title_en: Trump Signs 232 Provisions! 15% Tariff on Polysilicon Products and Minimum Import Price of $12 per Kilogram to Take Effect in December
paras: 美國總統川普周四 (6 日) 簽署公告，依據《1962 年貿易擴張法》第 232 條，對進口多晶矽 (polysilicon) 衍生產品課徵 15% 關稅，並同步設立最低進口價格，理由是美國過度依賴外國供應已危及國家安全。
新措施將於 12 月 4 日生效。根據公告，進口多晶矽衍生產品，包括矽晶圓、太陽能電池及太陽能模組等，都將適用於 15% 關稅。
公告中也指出，多晶矽最低進口價格訂為每公斤 21 美元，多晶矽錠與矽晶圓每公斤 100 美元，太陽能電池每瓦 0.22 美元，太陽能模組每瓦 0.38 美元。
多晶矽是一種超高純度矽材料，為半導體與太陽能產業供應鏈最上游原料。製造商先將其製成矽晶圓，再加工為太陽能電池，最後組裝成太陽能模組。
受消息激勵，美國太陽能製造商盤後股價走高。美國最大太陽能製造商第一太陽能 (First Solar)(FSLR-US) 一度大漲 8%，T1 Energy(TE-US)一度漲 6.3%。
川普此舉主要針對中國競爭，希望扶植美國本土多晶矽及相關產品生產，建立完整的美國太陽能供應鏈。
美國在 2000 年代初期至中期曾是全球主要多晶矽生產國，但後來中國企業快速崛起，至 2010 年代末已成為全球最大供應者。這十多年來，美國一直試圖重建美國的太陽能製造能力，但成效有限。
近年來，美國已多次對中國及部分東南亞國家的太陽能設備祭出反傾銷及反補貼措施，並指控部分海外業者藉由轉移生產地規避關稅。
不過，新關稅也可能推高太陽能模組成本，對原本已面臨聯邦補貼取消、且須因應川普政府偏向支持化石燃料政策的再生能源開發商，帶來新的壓力。

提供投資誘因 鼓勵回流美國設廠

川普也要求商務部建立投資獎勵機制，鼓勵企業赴美設立多晶矽及衍生產品工廠。
根據行政命令，商務部長可與企業簽訂個別投資協議，提供投資誘因。提出「回流美國」(onshoring) 計畫且獲批准的企業，還可免除部分生產設備及原料的新增關稅。
「繁榮美國聯盟」(Coalition for a Prosperous America) 主席 Jon Toomey 說：「這是美國首次透過單一政策保護整個太陽能供應鏈，同時獎勵在美投資設廠企業，也是強化本土半導體供應鏈的重要一步。」
不過，新措施延至 12 月才實施，引發部分美國製造商不滿。他們認為，這將讓再生能源開發商有時間大量進口低價產品並建立免稅庫存。
對此川普在公告中表示，政府將持續監控貿易流向，若發現企業藉機囤積多晶矽或相關產品，將採取限制措施。
paras_en: US President Trump signed an announcement on Thursday (6th) to impose a 15% tariff on imported polysilicon-derived products, including silicon wafers, solar cells, and solar modules, under Section 232 of the 1962 Trade Expansion Act, citing national security concerns due to over-reliance on foreign suppliers.

The new measures will take effect on December 4th. According to the announcement, all polysilicon-derived products, including silicon wafers, solar cells, and solar modules, will be subject to a 15% tariff.

The announcement also sets a minimum import price of $21 per kilogram for polysilicon, $100 per kilogram for polysilicon ingots and silicon wafers, $0.22 per watt for solar cells, and $0.38 per watt for solar modules.

Polysilicon is a high-purity silicon material that serves as the upstream raw material for the semiconductor and solar industries' supply chain. Manufacturers first produce it into silicon wafers, then process it into solar cells, and finally assemble it into solar modules.
Following the news, US solar manufacturers' stock prices surged. The largest US solar manufacturer, First Solar (FSLR-US), rose by 8%, while T1 Energy (TE-US) rose by 6.3%.
Trump's move is primarily aimed at China, hoping to support the development of domestic polysilicon and related products in the US, establishing a complete US solar supply chain.

The US was a major polysilicon producer in the early to mid-2000s, but Chinese companies rapidly rose to prominence, becoming the world's largest supplier by the end of the 2010s. Over the past decade, the US has been trying to rebuild its solar manufacturing capabilities, but with limited success.

In recent years, the US has repeatedly imposed anti-dumping and countervailing duties on solar equipment from China and some Southeast Asian countries, accusing some overseas companies of evading tariffs by transferring production.

However, the new tariffs may also increase the cost of solar modules, putting additional pressure on renewable energy developers who already face the cancellation of federal subsidies and the Trump administration's pro-fossil fuel policies.
Trump also called for the establishment of an investment incentive mechanism to encourage companies to set up polysilicon and related product factories in the US.

According to the executive order, the Commerce Secretary can sign individual investment agreements with companies, providing investment incentives. Companies that propose 'onshoring' plans and are approved can also be exempt from some of the new tariffs on production equipment and raw materials.

Jon Toomey, chairman of the 'Coalition for a Prosperous America,' said, 'This is the first time the US has protected the entire solar supply chain through a single policy, while also rewarding companies that invest in the US, and it's an important step in strengthening the domestic semiconductor supply chain.'

However, the delay in implementing the new measures until December has sparked discontent among some US manufacturers, who fear it will give renewable energy developers time to import cheap products and build up tax-free inventories.
Trump stated in the announcement that the government will continue to monitor trade flows and take restrictive measures if companies are found to be stockpiling polysilicon or related products.

items.title: 川普再聚焦疫苗與自閉症 傳最快下週發布行政命令 醫界憂再掀科學爭議
items.title_en: Trump Refocuses on Vaccine‑Autism Issue, Fastest Possible Executive Order Next Week Raises Medical Community Concerns
paras: 美國川普政府正考慮最快於下週發布一項與疫苗及自閉症有關的行政命令，顯示白宮可能進一步推動相關政策。根據《彭博》引述知情人士報導，此舉源自總統川普希望政府採取更多行動，但目前行政命令內容仍未定案，發布時程也仍可能調整。
截至目前，美國衛生與公共服務部 (HHS) 尚未回應相關報導，白宮也未正式證實行政命令內容。
近一年來，川普多次公開質疑疫苗與自閉症之間的關聯，並曾聲稱兒童疫苗及孕婦使用止痛藥 Tylenol(乙醯胺酚)可能與自閉症有關。然而，相關說法並未獲主流科學研究支持。美國疾病管制與預防中心 (CDC)、世界衛生組織(WHO) 及多項大型流行病學研究均指出，目前沒有可信科學證據證明兒童疫苗會導致自閉症。
市場也關注，美國衛生部長 Robert F. Kennedy Jr. 未來是否將扮演更重要角色。Kennedy 長期對疫苗安全性抱持質疑立場，今年 1 月重新改組負責制定全國自閉症政策建議的聯邦委員會，一口氣任命 21 名新成員，其中部分人士曾公開支持疫苗可能與自閉症有關的未經證實理論，引發醫學界關切。
事實上，川普政府今年以來已多次調整疫苗政策。今年 5 月，川普簽署行政命令，要求 CDC 及其疫苗諮詢委員會重新檢討美國兒童疫苗建議時程，並參考其他已開發國家的疫苗接種制度，希望調整美國核心兒童疫苗建議。白宮當時表示，此舉是為了建立「符合最佳科學證據」的疫苗政策，但相關措施仍引發醫學界不同意見。
不過，Kennedy 推動的部分疫苗政策今年 3 月已遭法院阻止。聯邦法院裁定，暫停其大幅修改兒童疫苗建議及重組 CDC 疫苗顧問委員會的部分措施，使行政部門推動相關改革受到法律限制。
近期美國媒體也陸續披露，川普持續要求 Kennedy 加強調查疫苗與自閉症議題。《華爾街日報》日前報導，川普今年 5 月曾親自要求 Kennedy 進一步研究兩者是否存在關聯，並希望重新檢討兒童疫苗接種建議，即使白宮部分政治幕僚原本希望在期中選舉前淡化疫苗議題。
專家指出，自閉症成因相當複雜，目前研究認為主要與遺傳及多重環境因素有關，但尚未找到單一原因。過去數十年，多項涵蓋數百萬名兒童的大型研究皆未發現兒童疫苗與自閉症存在因果關係。近期亦有醫學期刊指出，部分曾被引用支持疫苗與自閉症相關性的研究，因研究方法存在重大缺陷，已遭撤稿或重新審查。
分析人士認為，若白宮最終發布新的行政命令，勢必再度引發美國公共衛生政策、疫苗安全及科學證據之間的激烈辯論，也可能對 CDC 未來疫苗建議、自閉症研究方向及美國疫苗接種政策帶來新的影響。
paras_en: The Trump administration is reportedly considering issuing an executive order next week that would address vaccines and autism, indicating the White House may push related policies further. According to Bloomberg, citing informed sources, the move stems from President Trump’s desire for the government to take more action, though the order’s exact content remains undecided and the timeline could still shift.
To date, the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) has not responded to the reports, and the White House has not formally confirmed the order’s details.

Over the past year, Trump has repeatedly publicly questioned a link between vaccines and autism, even claiming that childhood vaccines and the pain reliever Tylenol (acetaminophen) used by pregnant women might be associated with autism. However, these claims lack support from mainstream scientific research. The CDC, WHO and numerous large‑scale epidemiological studies all state there is no credible scientific evidence that childhood vaccines cause autism.

The market is also watching whether Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. will assume a larger role. Kennedy has long cast doubt on vaccine safety and, in January, reshuffled the federal advisory committee that drafts national autism policy, appointing 21 new members, some of whom have publicly endorsed unverified theories linking vaccines to autism, prompting concern from the medical community.

In fact, the Trump administration has already altered vaccine policy several times this year. In May, Trump signed an executive order directing the CDC and its vaccine advisory committee to re‑examine the timing of U.S. childhood vaccine recommendations and to consider vaccination schedules used in other developed nations, aiming to revise core U.S. pediatric vaccine guidance. The White House said the move was intended to create a vaccine policy “aligned with the best scientific evidence,” though it has sparked dissent among health professionals.

However, parts of the vaccine policy championed by Kennedy were blocked by a court in March. A federal judge halted the sweeping changes to childhood vaccine recommendations and the restructuring of the CDC’s vaccine advisory panel, placing legal limits on the administration’s reform efforts.

Recent U.S. media reports reveal that Trump continues to press Kennedy to intensify investigations into the vaccine‑autism issue. The Wall Street Journal reported that in May Trump personally asked Kennedy to study whether a link exists and to revisit childhood vaccine recommendations, even as some White House aides had hoped to downplay the vaccine debate before the mid‑term elections.

Experts note that autism’s causes are highly complex, with current research pointing to genetic and multiple environmental factors rather than a single cause. Decades of large‑scale studies involving millions of children have found no causal relationship between vaccines and autism. Recent medical journals have also highlighted that some studies once cited as evidence for a vaccine‑autism link contained serious methodological flaws and have been retracted or reassessed.

Analysts say that if the White House ultimately issues a new executive order, it will likely reignite fierce debate over U.S. public‑health policy, vaccine safety and scientific evidence, and could affect future CDC vaccine guidance, autism research directions and America’s overall vaccination strategy.

items.title: 與OpenAI路線分道揚鑣！輝達低調組建AI安全團隊 押注開放權重模型
items.title_en: Diverging from OpenAI’s Path! Nvidia Quietly Forms AI Safety Team, Betting on Open-Weight Models
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，輝達正秘密籌組全新 AI 安全與網路工程團隊，強化開放權重模型時代的防禦縱深。
《Business Insider》週四報導指出，上月底一批招聘資訊首度曝光上述團隊，職缺涵蓋傑出工程師 (創始技術負責人)、安全研究工程師、評估工程師與資深經理，任務包括對尚未部署的 AI 智能體進行安全評估，並開發利用 AI 自動修復軟體漏洞的工具。
輝達在職缺描述中強調，團隊秉持「堅定信念」：開放權重、技術透明度與廣泛科學審查，是美國維持 AI 領先地位與強化網路防禦的基石。
此舉凸顯輝達在押注開放權重模型與自主智能體的同時，將 AI 安全提升至核心戰略。開放權重模型公開決定模型運行的訓練參數，但訓練數據與原始碼仍可保持封閉。
近月以來，輝達頻頻為開放模型站台，與 OpenAI、Anthropic 的閉源路線形成鮮明對照。
輝達執行長黃仁勳上月首度在 X 平台轉發公開信呼籲美國決策官員支持開放模型，直言開放能提高 AI 安全性並鞏固網路防線。
隨著 AI 從對話聊天機器人進化為可讀取企業敏感數據、調用工具並執行現實任務的智能體，企業對系統的信任度將決定普及速度。
分析人士指出，輝達此番組建專職安全團隊，既是為自家 GPU 生態護航，也是在 Agentic AI 爆發前夜，搶先卡位「安全即護城河」的產業標準制定權。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that Nvidia is secretly assembling a brand‑new AI safety and network engineering team to deepen defenses in the era of open‑weight models.

Business Insider reported on Thursday that a batch of job postings first surfaced at the end of last month for the team, covering roles such as distinguished engineer (founding technical lead), security research engineer, evaluation engineer and senior manager, with tasks that include safety assessments of yet‑to‑be‑deployed AI agents and development of tools that use AI to automatically patch software vulnerabilities.

In the job descriptions Nvidia stresses that the team operates under a “firm belief”: open weights, technical transparency and broad scientific review are the foundation for the United States to maintain AI leadership and strengthen cyber‑defense.

The move highlights that while Nvidia backs open‑weight models and autonomous agents, it is elevating AI safety to a core strategic priority. Open‑weight models make the training parameters that govern model behavior public, while the training data and source code can remain closed.
In recent months Nvidia has repeatedly championed open models, drawing a sharp contrast to the closed‑source approaches of OpenAI and Anthropic.

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang last month for the first time retweeted an open letter on X urging U.S. policymakers to support open models, stating that openness can improve AI safety and reinforce cyber defenses.
As AI evolves from chat‑based bots to agents that can read sensitive corporate data, invoke tools and perform real‑world tasks, corporate trust in the systems will dictate the speed of adoption.

Analysts say Nvidia’s creation of a dedicated safety team not only protects its own GPU ecosystem but also positions the company to set industry standards—treating safety as a moat—on the eve of an Agentic AI boom.

items.title: 土耳其、沙國、巴基斯坦將簽聯合防務協議 中東安全合作再升級
items.title_en: Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan to Sign Joint Defense Agreement, Raising Middle East Security Cooperation
paras: 根據兩名直接了解協議內容的區域消息人士透露，土耳其、沙烏地阿拉伯與巴基斯坦將於 8 日在沙烏地阿拉伯簽署一項聯合防務協議，象徵三國軍事合作進一步深化。在伊朗戰爭持續影響中東安全情勢、紅海與波斯灣緊張局勢未解之際，此舉被視為區域安全合作的重要里程碑。
截至目前，各方尚未公開協議具體內容，消息人士也未透露合作範圍、軍事承諾或執行機制。不過，協議預料將進一步提升三國在國防、情報交換、聯合演訓及區域安全事務上的合作程度。
分析人士指出，此次簽署時機正值中東安全局勢持續動盪。近期沙烏地阿拉伯與伊朗支持勢力之間緊張情勢升高，紅海與波斯灣航運安全受到衝擊，促使區域國家加快強化防衛合作，以因應能源設施、港口及海上航道面臨的安全風險。
巴基斯坦總理夏巴茲．夏立夫 (Shehbaz Sharif) 已率領高層代表團抵達吉達展開為期三天訪問，同行成員包括陸軍元帥阿西姆．穆尼爾 (Asim Munir) 等軍方高層。外界預期，雙方將討論軍事合作、區域安全及戰略夥伴關係等議題，而此次三方防務協議也將成為訪問的重要成果之一。
沙烏地阿拉伯與巴基斯坦近年軍事合作持續深化。路透社先前曾獨家披露，巴基斯坦於今年伊朗戰爭期間，依據雙方去年簽署的共同防禦協議，向沙國部署約 8,000 名官兵、一個戰鬥機中隊、防空系統及無人機等戰力，以協助保護沙國安全。消息人士指出，雙方保密協議甚至保留在必要時進一步擴大兵力部署的可能性。
此外，巴基斯坦近期也積極與其他波斯灣國家討論擴大安全合作，包括與科威特洽談新的防務合作架構，顯示伊斯蘭馬巴德正逐步擴展其在中東的安全角色，同時維持其在區域衝突中的外交斡旋地位。
市場人士認為，若土耳其、沙烏地阿拉伯與巴基斯坦正式建立新的三邊防務合作機制，將進一步強化三國在區域安全事務中的協調能力，也可能對中東未來的軍事合作架構及地緣政治平衡帶來深遠影響。不過，在協議正式公布前，其法律約束力、合作範圍及是否涉及共同防禦義務，仍有待官方進一步說明。
paras_en: According to two regional sources with direct knowledge of the agreement, Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan will sign a joint defense pact on the 8th in Saudi Arabia, symbolising a deepening of military cooperation among the three nations. With the ongoing Iran war continuing to affect Middle East security and tensions in the Red Sea and Persian Gulf unresolved, the move is seen as a major milestone in regional security cooperation.

So far, the parties have not disclosed the specific contents of the agreement, and the sources did not reveal the scope of cooperation, military commitments or implementation mechanisms. However, the pact is expected to further boost cooperation among the three countries in defence, intelligence sharing, joint exercises and regional security matters.

Analysts note that the timing of the signing comes as Middle East security remains volatile. Recent heightened tensions between Saudi Arabia and Iran‑aligned forces have impacted shipping safety in the Red Sea and Persian Gulf, prompting regional states to accelerate defence cooperation to address security risks to energy facilities, ports and sea lanes.

Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif has led a senior delegation to Jeddah for a three‑day visit, accompanied by senior military officials including Army Chief Asim Munir. Observers expect discussions on military cooperation, regional security and strategic partnership, and the trilateral defence agreement is expected to be a key outcome of the visit.

Saudi‑Pakistani military cooperation has been deepening in recent years. Reuters previously disclosed that during this year’s Iran war, Pakistan, under a mutual defence pact signed last year, deployed about 8,000 troops, a fighter squadron, air‑defence systems and drones to Saudi Arabia to help protect its security. Sources say the confidentiality agreement even leaves open the possibility of further force deployments if needed.

In addition, Pakistan has recently been actively discussing expanded security cooperation with other Gulf states, including talks with Kuwait on a new defence cooperation framework, showing that Islamabad is gradually expanding its security role in the Middle East while maintaining its diplomatic mediation position in regional conflicts.

Market observers believe that if Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan formally establish a new trilateral defence cooperation mechanism, it will enhance the three countries’ coordination on regional security issues and could have far‑reaching effects on the future military cooperation architecture and geopolitical balance in the Middle East. However, until the agreement is officially released, its legal binding force, scope of cooperation and whether it entails mutual defence obligations remain to be clarified by the authorities.

items.title: 美國禁止鎢廢料及電池廢棄物出口 強化本土關鍵礦產供應鏈
items.title_en: U.S. Bans Export of Tungsten Waste and Battery Waste to Strengthen Domestic Critical Mineral Supply Chain
paras: 《路透社》報導，美國商務部周四 (6 日) 表示，將禁止鎢廢料及電池廢棄物出口，以推動美國國內回收產業發展，並提升關鍵礦產生產力。
這項措施符合市場預期。美國總統川普上周已簽署行政命令，授權聯邦官員限制含有高價值關鍵礦產的廢料出口至中國及其他國家。
這項命令禁止出口的項目包括俗稱「黑粉」的材料，即經粉碎處理的鋰離子電池，以及含有鎢的廢料。鎢廣泛用於提高鋼材硬度，也是國防工業的重要材料。
此舉是美國降低對中國依賴的最新措施之一。中國目前主導全球關鍵礦產加工，相關礦物廣泛應用於電動車電池、武器系統等產品。
隨著美中在關鍵礦產供應上的競爭升溫，華府近年持續透過出口管制、關稅及國內補助等政策，重建美國本土供應鏈。
根據刊登於「聯邦公報」(Federal Register) 的命令，美國商務部工業與安全局表示，新規將於 8 月 27 日生效，實施期限為一年。
華府智庫 SAFE 關鍵礦產政策經理 Zubeyde Oysul 表示，「很高興看到政府認識到，從廢料中回收可再利用的關鍵材料的重要性。」
根據命令，只有企業能證明將遭受「過度困難」或「無法彌補的損害」時，政府才可能逐案核發豁免。
環境組織 Basel Action Network 數據顯示，美國每月出口近 3.3 萬公噸電子廢棄物及其他廢料，其中許多都含有可回收再利用的關鍵礦產。
這類出口長期以來引發美國回收業者不滿。業界認為，若能將這些材料留在國內，將有助於美國提升關鍵礦產生產能力。
不過，美國目前仍缺乏足夠的回收產能，無法處理所有產生的廢料。且過去 18 個月來，多家回收企業也面臨經營困境，包括 Li-Cycle(LICYQ-US) 及 Ascend Elements 均已聲請破產。
私人鎢回收公司 Amermin 對這項禁令表示歡迎，但也認為，美國仍須進一步提升國內廢料處理能力。
Amermin 執行長 Ryan McAdams 表示，「這項禁令只是權宜之計。它能替我們爭取更多時間，但我們仍必須開始在美國本土建立相關基礎設施。」
McAdams 透露，Amermin 去年獲得美國能源部 1,150 萬美元補助，但資金至今尚未撥付。他表示，若當時能取得這筆資金，公司商業化回收工廠至少可提前六個月營運。
paras_en: Reuters reported that the U.S. Department of Commerce on Thursday (the 6th) announced a ban on the export of tungsten waste and battery waste to promote the development of domestic recycling industries and boost productivity of critical minerals.

The move aligns with market expectations. President Trump signed an executive order last week authorizing federal officials to restrict the export of waste containing high‑value critical minerals to China and other countries.

The order bars the export of material colloquially known as “black powder,” which is crushed lithium‑ion battery waste, as well as waste containing tungsten. Tungsten is widely used to harden steel and is a key material for the defense industry.

The step is one of the latest U.S. measures to reduce reliance on China, which currently dominates global processing of critical minerals used in electric‑vehicle batteries, weapon systems and other products.
As competition with China over critical‑mineral supplies heats up, Washington has in recent years been rebuilding the domestic supply chain through export controls, tariffs and domestic subsidies.
According to the order published in the Federal Register, the Commerce Department’s Bureau of Industry and Security said the new rule will take effect on August 27 and will be in force for one year.
SAFE think‑tank critical‑minerals policy manager Zubeyde Oysul said, “We’re pleased to see the government recognize the importance of recovering reusable critical materials from waste.”
The order allows exemptions only on a case‑by‑case basis when a company can demonstrate it would face “excessive difficulty” or “irreparable harm” without the export.
Data from the Basel Action Network shows the United States exports roughly 33,000 metric tons of electronic waste and other waste each month, much of which contains recoverable critical minerals.
Such exports have long drawn complaints from U.S. recyclers, who argue that keeping these materials domestically would help boost the country’s critical‑mineral production capacity.

However, the United States still lacks sufficient recycling capacity to handle all generated waste, and over the past 18 months several recyclers, including Li‑Cycle (LICYQ‑US) and Ascend Elements, have filed for bankruptcy.
Private tungsten recycler Amermin welcomed the ban but said the U.S. still needs to further improve its domestic waste‑processing capabilities.
Amermin CEO Ryan McAdams said, “The ban is only a stopgap. It buys us more time, but we still have to start building the necessary infrastructure here in the United States.”

McAdams disclosed that Amermin received a $11.5 million grant from the U.S. Department of Energy last year, but the funds have not yet been disbursed. He said that if the money had been received, the company’s commercial recycling plant could have been operational at least six months earlier.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走強 避險需求升溫 殖利率上揚
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Strengthens as Hedge Demand Rises and Yields Climb
paras: 美元周四 (6 日) 走強，升至一周高點，受避險需求升溫及美國公債殖利率上揚支撐，市場同時靜待周五公布的關鍵就業數據。另一方面，日元兌美元跌破 158，為上周日本當局干預匯市以來首見。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數 (DXY) 上漲 0.3%，報 99.94，前一交易日曾跌至七周低點。
美元這周稍早一度走弱，投資人轉向股票等風險性資產，帶動華爾街在 7 月表現平淡後強勢展開 8 月行情。
此外，市場預期荷姆茲海峽 (Strait of Hormuz) 有望重新開放，也推動油價下跌，提振市場風險偏好。
不過，原油價格周四明顯反彈。媒體報導指出，伊朗與阿曼擬定的荷姆茲海峽重啟框架，將禁止美國船舶通行，直到相關賠償完成為止。
伊朗《法斯通訊社》(Fars) 引述國會議員 Alireza Salimi 報導，荷姆茲海峽方案初步文本目前正由當局審查。根據方案，在賠償完成前，美國、以色列及其他「敵對國家」船舶將不得通行這條重要航道。
《法斯通訊社》另引述伊朗外交部消息人士指出，依照方案，船舶將由靠近伊朗海岸的北側航道進入荷姆茲海峽，並由靠近阿曼海岸的南側航道離開。在特定期限後，兩側航道都將停止通行，改由中央航道取代，屆時將由伊朗負責入境管理，出境則由伊朗與阿曼共同管理。
若上述方案屬實，其中部分內容預料難以獲得華府接受。
美國總統川普本周稍早表示，由於和平協議談判取得進展，他已取消原定對伊朗發動的強力軍事攻擊，但也警告，若雙方無法達成協議，美國已「準備好採取行動」。自 2 月底戰爭爆發以來，美伊雙方持續在威脅、攻擊與讓步之間反覆交鋒。
非農就業報告公布在即
美元周四也受到市場對貨幣政策前景的不安情緒支撐。投資人拋售美國公債，推升美債殖利率。市場焦點轉向周五公布的 7 月非農就業報告，預料將成為聯準會利率走向的重要觀察指標。
本周公布的勞動市場數據表現不一。美國 6 月職缺增幅低於預期，也較 5 月放緩，7 月 ADP 民間就業新增人數同樣不及市場預期，且增幅較 6 月降溫。
另一方面，美國首次申領失業金人數已連續第三周低於 20 萬人，這種情況自 1960 年代末以來相當罕見。
整體而言，數據顯示美國勞動市場仍具韌性，也支持聯準會近期將政策重心重新放回抑制通膨。同時，中東衝突導致油價波動，改變了通膨走勢，也讓聯準會官員對未來貨幣政策方向出現分歧。
Interactive Brokers 資深經濟學家 José Torres 表示，「我預期 7 月新增就業人數將連續第四個月放緩，估計僅增加 4 萬人。勞動市場正受到供給限制影響，勞動參與率大幅下滑、勞動力規模縮減，同時薪資壓力持續升高。」
他指出，「即使失業率維持偏低，只要整體新增就業數據疲弱，就足以帶動美國公債反彈。因為一旦固定收益市場投資人開始擔心企業可能縮減人力，市場就會開始反映經濟放緩風險。」
但他也表示，「目前中東局勢仍是市場關注焦點，因此無論非農就業報告結果如何，華爾街最在意的仍是美國與伊朗之間的互動。」
日元干預後首跌破 158
除了美元之外，匯市另一大焦點仍是日元。
美元兌日元上漲 0.4%，至 158.39，為近期日本當局大規模干預匯市以來，首次重新站上 158。
美國財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent) 這周稍早證實，美國已與日本聯手進場買進日元，這是 2011 年以來兩國首次聯合干預匯市，也是美國自 1998 年以來首次直接出手。
貝森特周二接受 CNBC 訪問時表示，美方之所以協助日本，是因為日元若持續走弱，可能衝擊整個亞洲金融市場。
在此次干預前，日元一度跌至 1 美元兌 164 日元，創 40 年新低。
RSM US 經濟學家 Joseph Brusuelas 表示，「別搞錯了，干預措施之後，日本必須推出真正的政策改變，而這代表政策利率需要上調，才能證明這筆投入的資金是值得的。」
